_note: PLACEHOLDER names, not final text (design/proposals/merc-pilot-names.md 5.6, 5.7). This file is the only place the names live:
tools/gen_pilots.py writes merge/Pilots.xml (one GamePilot TRF_McP_<clan>_<slot>_<gen> per name) and
Data/Scripts/Mods/Traffic/merc_names.script (TRF_Mc_Names, TRF_McName) from it. Rerun the tool after an edit.
Per clan (key of RecruitAce_<clan> in Game/Pilots.xml): rc = the #RC_FLIGHT_NAME<rc> index in LocData/English/m_recruits.loc
(and the face recruits<rc>), unit = that unit name, names = 5 slots (0 leader, 1-4 aces) x 2 generations (0, 1).
Rules (checked by the tool): 120 names, unique ignoring case, printable ASCII without & < > " \, at most max_len characters;
gen_pilots.py --locdata also checks that no name occurs in the game's English .loc files or in the mod's text.

morgenstern.style: surnames, terse (professional record, Mercenary Code, tacticians)

fireaxe.style: blunt nicknames (crush armour, fire and clear space)

stardragoon.style: rank and surname for the leader, surnames for the aces (military academies)

kimmeria.style: short, hard names (war cry, from Avalon to Kitaro)

nomads.style: wanderers' single names (clearing star systems since the Fall of the Titan)

blacklegion.style: Roman names, leader titled Legate (Ave!, roots in Earth's ancient past)

shinegard.style: formal given name and surname (glorious deeds, safety)
